what: Video and photo inside (data-fx-part="media") rendered in black and white with WebGL, erasing pixels whose brightness is below a threshold to the background color. Lowering the threshold 1 → .1 over 1.5s (power1.out) makes the image emerge from the dark starting with the brightest areas, and leaving the screen or sending fx:out sinks it back along the same path. ±.03 film noise, with the seed rotated by .1 each frame, is laid over it

options.grain: Film grain strength, default .03 (0 turns it off)
options.on: if manual, it does not start when it enters the screen but via fx:play and fx:out (to match section changes)
options.--fx-luma-bg: Color painted over erased pixels (css variable), default --kf-surface

use: <section data-fx="luma-threshold-video" style="height: 100vh"><video data-fx-part="media" src="…" muted loop playsinline></video></section>
note: The original swaps a set of three(r85) full-screen planes while making the same shader decision (brightness < gray ? background : grayscale) was applied — the part was newly written in bare WebGL fitted to a single panel, without three. It draws only same-origin video (other origins need crossorigin)

from.where: shared.js BackgroundCanvas (original backgroundCanvas) — fadeIn·fadeOut of the three black-and-white background videos on the first page
